Commentary.Commentary: The Windies bowling started off really well but lost gas as the game progressed. Their spinners were quite impressive and one would wonder why Badree was not given his full quota of overs. Especially with the pacers taking a pounding. Now though they need to put all that behind and concentrate on their batting. They do have the firepower to chase this down but it won't be easy. Will they do so and take the series or will Bangladesh end up on level terms. Join us in a while to find out.

An excellent recovery from Bangladesh. They end up with a score which is more than competitive. After being inserted they once again failed to get a good start as they lost three wickets before reaching the 50-run mark. Then the two Bangladeshi legends took matters in their hands. They counter-attacked and stitched a 90-run stand from just 50 balls. Yes, Tamim was dropped but take nothing away from his innings. He provided the impetus the innings needed by smashing Russell for 22 in his penultimate over before falling to him. However, Shakib continued and he, along with Mahmudullah has taken the visitors to a total they will be happy with.
So no boundaries in the final over but Bangladesh do manage to get 9 from it. Another full delivery on middle, Mahmudullah hits it down the ground for a couple. BANGLADESH END WITH 171!
Another single results as Haque guides this towards point.
Again no boundary, just a single I should write. A very full delivery on the pads. Mahmudullah flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Ariful Haque comes in next.

OUT! Shakib holes out! Half the side back in the hut for Bangladesh. A low full toss outside off, not always easy to put such deliveries away and Shakib could not. He hits it up in the air towards long off. Walton, the substitute, takes an easy catch. Shakib walks back after playing an innings of substance. This till now has been a good final over by Paul.
Full and wide outside off, Shakib slashes, he gets an outside edge down to third man for a couple.
Slower ball and way outside off. Shakib lets it be. Wide signaled.

Full outside off by Paul who is back into the attack. Shakib tries to force it through the off side but he gets it off the inner half, past the diving bowler and some good running helps them take two.
Fuller in length on middle, eased down to mid on for a run. So, 13 from this over, a good one for the visitors especially after the last one was a quiet one.
The batsman has taken the aerial route and played that over the covers. They pick up a single.
In the air but safe. Full outside off, Mahmudullah slices it over covers. No man in the deep and a couple results.

FOUR! STREAKY! Bangladesh will take it no matter how it comes. A yorker outside off, Mahmudullah tries to jam it out but he gets a bottom edge past the keeper. The fielder at third man runs to his left and dives over the ball. So, two boundaries in the three balls bowled.

NOT OUT! Pitched outside leg. Windies' only review goes down the drain. A good comeback delivery though by Carlos after going for a boundary on the first ball. Very full around leg. Shakib tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal  but the umpire shakes his head. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen run a leg bye. Brathwaite then signals for the review and the replay rolls in. It shows the ball to be pitching outside leg.
A huge appeal for LBW has not been given. Shakib is the man in question. The ball looks to be pitching outside the leg stump.
FOUR! Another gift and these have to be put away. He serves a full toss on the pads, Shakib flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary. Ideal start to the over, pressure on the bowler now.
Carlos Brathwaite is back on.
So just 3 from Russell's last. He finishes his spell with figures of 4-0-33-1. Not bad, especially after 22 were scored in a single over. He bangs this short and Mahmudullah is late on the pull.
Slower and on the shorter side outside off, Shakib slaps it towards the cover fielder who makes a diving stop. Can't stop the single though.
Another yorker outside off, Shakib goes after it but does not connect.

Excellent cricket all around there. A brilliant delivery first by Russell. A corker of a yorker. Mahmudullah does well to jam it out towards the leg side. The batsmen go for a quick run. Russell gets to the ball quickly and while he is turning, he has a shy at his end but misses. Had he hit, Mahmudullah was a goner.
Slower ball on middle, Mahmudullah works it to mid-wicket.

Fifty for Shakib, his first as captain in T20Is and it has come at a time when Bangladesh needed it. A do-or-die game, your team in trouble, and the skipper has led from the front. His job though is not done yet as he needs to stay there and take his side to a good total. He gets to the milestone by slapping the ball to the man at sweeper cover. Raises his bat to soak in the applause from the crowd.
Again moves across the stumps and flicks it to fine leg. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Superb timing from Shakib. He gets a full ball outside off and creams it wide of the cover fielder.
A back of a length ball in line of the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for another single.
Moves away to play the shortish ball and gets it to mid off for a run.

Wide not given and rightly so. It is a slower ball from Williams to which Shakib moves across to work it fine, however, he misses it. The ball goes just past the leg stump. Shakib is livid with himself on missing out on this.
Short outside off, guided wide of third man for a run.
Kesrick Williams to have a go now.
Mahmudullah walks out to the middle.

OUT! Russell has the last laugh and the Windies will be relieved to see the back of Tamim. Russell goes full again on middle, Tamim clears his front leg and tries to go downtown but fails to get the desired connection. It has got more height than distance and Paul at long on takes a good catch. End of a magnificent innings by the opener and also the 90-run stand. He made full use of the life he got and walks off to a standing ovation. 22 and a wicket from this over. What a roller-coaster!

SIX! Make that 22! Tamim Iqbal is on fire. Full, length, back of a length and now short. Bowl anywhere to him and he will hit you. Russell goes for the bumper but maybe Tamim was expecting it. He is in position early as he pulls it over the mid-wicket fence.
FOUR! So, 16 from the first 4 balls. Slower ball on off, Tamim picks his spot and hits it over mid off and the ball trickles over the fence.
SIX! This time he has hit that right off the middle. Another biggie. Once again it is the length ball on middle, Tamim pulls it over the mid-wicket fence.
Tamim would have felt he missed out there. A full toss outside off, Tamim swings but misses.
SIX! Welcome back into the attack Russell, says Tamim. What a shot. The key there was he picked the length early. On the shorter side, not very short. Tamim half-pulls it over long on for a biggie.
Andre Russell comes back to bowl the 16th over.
Driven through the covers by Tamim. They pick up a single. 11 off this one and Bangladesh are on the charge now.
Full outside off, guided to short third man for a run.

SIX! SHOT! Quality from Shakib, showing his class. Paul bowls a length ball on off, Shakib gets under it and lofts it over covers. The fielder there tries to get a hand to it but it goes over him and clears the fence for a maximum.
Low full toss around off, Tamim looks to power it through covers but his hand comes off the bat. A run taken in the end.
Nice comeback. A yorker and it evades the bat of Tamim.
50 for Tamim Iqbal. Bangladesh would want him to continue. An overpitched ball on middle, he drives it through covers and takes a brace to bring up the milestone. His 6th in this format.
Keemo Paul is back on.
Tries to innovate again by playing the scoop. This time though he does not connect and 2 dots to end the over. But a good one for the visitors as 9 runs came from it.
A good yorker outside off, Shakib tries to jam it out but misses.

FOUR! This adds salt to the wound. Had Powell taken the catch, Shakib would not have been on strike and this shot would not have been played. The Bangladesh skipper, shuffles right across and scoops it over short fine leg and fetches a boundary.

DROPPED! Rovman Powell is the culprit. He drops an absolute sitter. Tamim uses his feet again and gets a short ball outside off. He slaps it towards mid off. Powell there gets two hands to it but can't hang on. The batsmen run through for a single. Brathwaite is not a happy man and why would he be? Tamim is not someone you drop, especially after he has got his eye in. The opener would now look to make the hosts pay big time.
Back of a length closer to the off pole. Iqbal guides it to point.

FOUR! Raining boundaries here in Florida! Tamim gets into the act this time. Not in a convincing manner though but he won't care. Uses his feet and slashes at the ball. It takes the outside edge and goes over short third man for the 4th boundary in the last 7 balls. 100 up for Bangladesh and also the 50-run stand comes up between the two. A vital one as Bangladesh were in big trouble when they got together.
FOUR!  A boundary to begin the over and one to end it. 14 from this over. Another gift from Williams. A bouncer down the leg side. Shakib swivels and pulls it through short fine leg for a boundary.
Tamim this time uses his feet but only tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shakib surely is trying to do so as he skips down the track but Williams bowls a decent slower one. The batsman works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.

FOUR! 4,0,4 is how this over reads till now. Shakib makes room and Williams follows him by digging it short. Shakib does the smart thing as he helps it on its way through backward square leg. 8 from the first half of the over, can the visitors make this a big one?
Good comeback by the bowler. Shortens his length and bowls it outside off. Shakib tries to cut but misses.
FOUR! In the gap! Too easy for Shakib, full and outside off. Shakib reaches out for it and hits it over covers. No fielder in the deep and a boundary results.
A single to end the over as Shakib pulls it to deep square leg. A good over for the visitors, 8 from it.

In the air... but safe! Good fielding in the end. A clever shot by Tamim, he shuffles across and flicks it effortlessly. The ball lands in between deep mid-wicket and deep square leg. Russell there runs to his left, dives and saves a run for his side.
Cramps the batsman for room as he angles it into the batsman and bowls it on a back of a length. Shakib half-pulls it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Slightly shorter on middle, Tamim pulls it through square leg for  a run.
The batsman has flat batted that through the point region. They pick up a single.
Not an attacking approach by Tamim this time as he guides it down to third man for a run.
Carlos Brathwaite is into the attack.

Again an off pace ball. Shakib swings but gets an inside edge towards the keeper. So it is clear, both the batsmen have now decided to step on the gas as they have started to play a few shots. Though none of them is hitting them cleanly.

FOUR! EDGED and over the keeper's head! No fielder there so a boundary results. Bangladesh needed this. Slower delivery on middle, Shakib is way too early into his slog. He gets a top edge over the keeper and into the fence.
Slower ball and on the shorter side. Shakib is early into the cut and he mistimes it to covers.
Shorter in length, Tamim cuts it through point for a run.
Well fielded! On the fuller side and it is the seam up delivery. Tamim hits it through extra cover. Russell at long off runs to his right and saves two for his side.
Starts off with a slower ball outside off, Tamim strokes it to covers.
Kesrick Williams to have a bowl now.
On a length around off, Shakib fails to put bat to ball. No run to end the 10th over. Bangladesh are 67/3.
Full on off, punched to long on for a run.
Shortish outside off, guided to third man for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
FOUR! Two in two. Shakib is into the act now. Paul bowls a full ball around off, Shakib lines it up and gets it up and over covers. A boundary results and some momentum for the visitors.
FOUR! Short and punished! Shakib cuts it over point and gets a boundary.
Shakib rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Punched to long on for a run by Tamim. 4 singles off the 4 balls.
Shortish in line of the stumps, punched off the back foot down the ground for another single.
Charges down the track to play the flighted ball on off. Gets it to long off and takes a run.
Flatter on off, punched to covers. One run taken.
Change of ends for Ashley Nurse.
FOUR! 50 up for Bangladesh! A full ball on the pads, Iqbal flicks it fine and gets a boundary. He is looking in good touch tonight.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Shakib Al Hasan is the next man in.

OUT! High, so high and taken! Intelligent stuff from Paul, he bowls a slower full delivery wide of off stump. Sarkar goes with the lofted shot without compensating for the pace. Ends up mistiming it up in the air towards long on where Powell positions himself under it and takes a good catch. Windies continue to chip away at the wickets.
Full around off, driven to mid off for nothing.
It's been lofted over mid on by Tamim. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Innovative and effective. Tamim moves across to flick the length ball and gets it through square leg for a boundary. Pressure on Paul.
Keemo Paul is on.
FOUR! Superb timing and awareness. Sarkar gets an overpitched ball outside off. He stays still and uses the pace to place it through backward point for a boundary.
Copy paste stuff from the bowler and the batsman.
Looks to back away to play the back of a length ball towards third man but misses.
Lofts the full ball over mid off for another brace.
On a length around off, guided to third man for a run.
Sarkar fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad. One run added to the total. A leg bye signalled by the umpire.

Lofts it again but doesn't get the right connection this time. It goes over Carlos at mid off. A run taken. End of the Powerplay and yet again, the Windies will be the happier side of the two after the first 6.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
SIX! Nice and easy. A good looking shot from Sarkar this. He gets a flighted ball on off, he waits for it and lofts it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Sarkar moves away and seeing that, Nurse bowls a flat ball wide outside off.
Flatter on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Loopy on leg, worked to fine leg for a run.

Yes, he can! He bowls another beauty! Good length delivery and it pitches and skids off the surface. Sarkar is late in bringing his bat down and it goes into the mitts of the keeper. Excellent over by Russell. Just a run from it.
Make that a single from the 5 deliveries bowled! Very full and outside off, Sarkar jams it out to point. Can Russell finish the over well?
OHHHHH! This is lovely stuff from Russell. He steams in and bangs in a short ball with a lot of fizz. Sarkar does really well to evade it at the last moment. Just a single from the first 4 balls.
Goes slightly fuller this time and the line is outside off, the ball stays a touch low after pitching. Sarkar tries to keep it out but is beaten.
And again, another pacey bumper. Tamim goes for the pull but the ball rushes onto him. He mistimes it towards square leg for a single.
Good pace to begin with. A back of a length delivery at 144 clicks. Tamim tries to pull but is late onto the shot. It hits the higher portion of the bat and goes towards mid on.
Andre Russell is into the attack.
Flatter on middle and off, driven to mid on for no run. End of another successful over for Windies.
A touch short outside off, guided to third man for a run.
Driven through mid on by Sarkar. They pick up a single.

OUT! One shot too many from Rahim. Nurse has his second but it's a gift from Rahim to be honest. After playing a ramp shot off the previous ball, he looks to play the reverse hit but all he could manage is to lob the ball in the air. It goes towards point and Russell there takes an easy catch running back. Bangladesh lose their second and the Rahim experiment hasn't worked. Soumya Sarkar replaces him.

Rahim doing what he does best. Straightaway looks to play the ramp shot over the keeper's head. Moves across and gets into position but doesn't get the desired connection. The ball lobs in the air and lands behind the keeper. A brace results.
Shortish around off, punched off the back foot through covers. One run results.
Wide! Down the leg side, Tamim misses the flick. Wide signalled.
Punches the flatter ball to long on and keeps the strike for the next over.
SIX! Bang! What a hit. Iqbal is into the act. A flighted ball on off, Tamim lofts it nonchalantly over covers and deposits it over the fence for a maximum. First of the game.
Gets back and keeps it out.
Around off, defended.

FOUR! Edged but safe! Badree bowls a nice loopy delivery outside off, inducing an outside edge of Tamim's flashing blade. The ball runs to the third man fence for a boundary. Bangladesh won't mind it though.
Flighted on off, swept to square leg for a run.
Rahim flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single. Bangla Tigers under pressure once again in the Powerplay.
Mushfiqur Rahim has been promoted up the order.

OUT! Uppish and gone! Who's the destroyer again? Ashley Nurse. He bowls an off spinner around off, Das lunges forward and drives it uppishly wide of mid off. However, Brathwaite moves from mid off to his left and takes a good low catch. Bangladesh lose their first in the second over.
Slow and flat, no room on offer, defended.
Iqbal flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Down the leg side, Tamim looks to get bat to ball but seems to have missed it. The ball evades the keeper as well and runs to the fence. However, the umpire signals a boundary. So there was probably bat involved.
Shortish around off, punched off the back foot to covers.
So spinners from both ends as Ashley Nurse will bowl from the other end. He took two wickets in his first over in the last game. Can he do the same?
Again fast and in line of the stumps from Badree. Tamim punches it to mid-wicket and keeps the strike for the next over. A tidy start from Badree.
Shorter and faster on off, blocked off the back foot.
Quicker again on off, defended.
Slower floated ball on off, worked to long on for the first run.
Flatter on middle and leg, Das gets away to punch it to covers.
Starts with a flighted ball on middle which Das pushes to short mid-wicket.

Time to rock 'n roll! The players are on the field and we're all set to go. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das is the opening duo for Bangladesh while Samuel Badree will take the new ball for Windies. Here we go...

Bangladesh captain, Shakib Al Hasan, says that he wanted to bowl first as he isn't sure what a good score will be on this pitch. Adds that the track looks good. Further adds that they have one change in the side as Abu Hider replaces Mehidy Hasan.

Windies captain, Carlos Brathwaite, says that they will field first and look to chase the target down later on. Further adds that the pitch looks good and will look to put the opposition under pressure with some good bowling upfront. Ends by saying that they will look to execute their plans and chase well.
Toss - Windies win the toss and choose to field.

Pitch report - Jeff Dujon reports from the pitch and says that it looks flat. Adds that there is no grass on the track and the spinners will enjoy bowling on this. Implies that it will be a good one to bat on.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the second T20I between Windies and Bangladesh in Florida. A do-or-die game for the visitors after they were thumped in the first one. A better outing will be expected from them this time around. The Windies, on the other hand, will look to continue their momentum and seal the series here itself. Let us hope for an equal battle between bat and ball. The action starts in a while, stay tuned!
